scripts.doc:check: bun --no-env-file --config=config/kit/bunfig.gates.toml --no-install run scripts/kit/check-doc-hygiene.ts && bun --no-env-file --config=config/kit/bunfig.gates.toml --no-install run scripts/kit/check-adr-frontmatter.ts && bun --no-env-file --config=config/kit/bunfig.gates.toml --no-install run scripts/kit/check-qualified-refs.ts
scripts.test:doc-hygiene: bash scripts/kit/test-doc-hygiene.sh && bash scripts/kit/test-adr-frontmatter.sh && bash scripts/kit/test-qualified-refs.sh
scripts.i18n:check: bun run --filter @kit/example-web test -- src/messages/messages.contract.test.ts && bun run --filter @kit/example-api test -- src/messages/messages.contract.test.ts
scripts.license:check: bun run scripts/kit/licenseChecker.ts && bun run scripts/kit/licenseChecker.ts --self-test
scripts.quality-gates:check: env -u QG_FILE_EXEMPTIONS -u QG_FILE_MAX -u QG_FILE_ROOTS -u QG_FILE_PRODUCT_EXEMPTIONS QG_FILE_MODE=tree bash scripts/kit/check_file_length.sh && env -u QG_FOLDER_EXEMPTIONS -u QG_FOLDER_MAX -u QG_FOLDER_ROOTS -u QG_FOLDER_PRODUCT_EXEMPTIONS bash scripts/kit/check_folder_size.sh
scripts.validate: bun run lint && bun run typecheck && bun run typecheck:tooling && bun run test && bun run banlist && bun run zod-major && bun run ts-major && bun run extract-dry-run && bun run zero-edit && bun run env:check && bun run wrangler-migrations:check
scripts.validate:full: bun run scripts/kit/root-gate.ts lint typecheck typecheck:tooling banlist zod-major ts-major test:ts-major test:merge-gate extract-dry-run test:extract-dry-run zero-edit import-boundary test:import-boundary tsconfig-orphans:check test:tsconfig-orphans test:coverage-order test:deny-upstream test:lefthook-deletes test:trufflehog-pin test:promote-deploy deploy-gate:check test:hermetic-git migrations-contract:check test:migrations-contract test:file-length test:folder-size test:dogfood-zero-edit test:kit-schema-sync check:bar-ssot test:bar-ssot test:root-gate test:falsify wrangler-migrations:check test:wrangler-migrations test:cf-builds test:zod-entry-init debt:check test:debt agents-adr:check openapi:check doc:check test:doc-hygiene bun-version:check test:bun-version lock-ranges:check test:lock-ranges stack-contract:check test:stack-contract actions-pin:check test:actions-pin test:deps-guard env:check test:coverage license:check quality-gates:check build:kit smoke:mcp knip test:knip-config test:biome-strict
scripts.deploy-gate:check: SOURCE_BRANCH=main bun --no-env-file --config=config/kit/bunfig.gates.toml scripts/kit/promote-deploy.ts --check && if git rev-parse -q --verify refs/remotes/origin/deploy/staging >/dev/null; then SOURCE_BRANCH=staging bun --no-env-file --config=config/kit/bunfig.gates.toml scripts/kit/promote-deploy.ts --check; fi
